# CANDIDATE: GAP_UP_RSI_EXTREME_FADE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An extended gap up with overbought RSI often reverses as intraday liquidity fills the gap. The edge exists because strong opening gaps with weak volume and overextended momentum attract contrarian liquidity as market participants fade the initial imbalance, particularly when RSI indicates exhaustion.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** If opening gap > 0.5% (open > prior close × 1.005) AND RSI(14) of the gap bar > 70 AND volume of the gap bar < average volume of the prior 20 bars, enter short at retracement to VWAP or prior close (whichever is higher).  
**Exit:** Stop placed above gap high (gap bar high + minimum tick). TP1 at gap fill (prior close) for 2/3 position. Remaining 1/3 runner trailed using Chandelier exit (ATR-based, params.json) if price continues down. Regime filter: VIX > 18. Time filter: first 30 minutes RTH. Avoid if EMA ribbon strongly bullish (fast > pivot > slow with spread > 30c).
